messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 - elevated 5xx and tail latency observed across eu-west and apac regions. Paging oncall (Jordan).
Maya (SRE): seeing 5xx spike ~00:05 UTC, errors concentrated on economy tier. Latency also up for premium but fewer errors.
Jordan (Oncall): on it. any known deploys?
Priya (SRE): no deploys. Telemetry shows sudden change in smart-routing decisions — a new policy rollout yesterday may be misclassifying session metadata.
Ken (Routing): I can confirm: rollout flagged requests with missing region header as 'default->premium' which routes through GPU pool A. That pool is saturated.
Toby (Support): we have 4 support tickets from customers in EU complaining about timeouts, one is a paid customer. Raising severity with CS.
Jordan (Oncall): priority: protect paid customers, reduce error rate. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) apply aggressive rate-limit on economy tier; 2) reroute misclassified traffic to regional fallback lane; 3) disable the new policy rollout. Thoughts?
Maya (SRE): agree. Also suggest temporary per-tenant quota bump for the affected paid customer while we re-route their traffic to healthy pool.
Ken (Routing): I can flip rollout flag and adjust weights. Pushing disable now.
Ken (Routing): (bot) POST /routing/rollouts/flag -d '{"policy_id":"policy-2026-09-eu-default","enabled":false}'
IncidentBot: Rollout flag change queued by Ken, awaiting commit.
Ken (Routing): commit done. Response: 200 OK. Policy disabled.
Maya (SRE): nice. I'm going to apply a temporary smart-route override to pin premium customer traffic to fast-lane in eu-west while we scrub logs. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/v1/route-override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"match":{"tenant_id":"acct-9876"},"route":"eu-west-fast-lane","expires_in_s":3600}'
```
Jordan (Oncall): doing a quick rate-limit on economy globally: set economy per-tenant rps to 20.
Priya (SRE): applying now, pushed a quota change: economy_rps_per_tenant=20.
IncidentBot: Quota update applied by Priya.
Toby (Support): Customer acct-9876 confirmed they see improvement after being routed to fast-lane. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Oncall): telemetry shows 5xxs dropping in eu-west, tail latency normalizing. Good. Next: investigate why region header missing created misclass. Ken, can we add a safe-guard to avoid defaulting to premium?
Ken (Routing): yes. I'll change default mapping to 'regional-fallback' and add a circuit-breaker: if route weight to premium > 0.6 and backend latency > 200ms then cut weight by 50%. Making change now.
Ken (Routing): (snippet) new mapping: {"default_route":"regional-fallback","circuit_breaker_ms":200} -> applied
Maya (SRE): also found that prefix-KV cache miss rate spiked when traffic landed on GPU pool A; cache warming will lag. We'll add a small warmup buffer by temporarily enabling prefix caching at ingress for 10 minutes.
Priya (SRE): enabling prefix caching now (10m).
IncidentBot: Prefix caching toggle applied by Priya.
Jordan (Oncall): customer-facing impact: 7 customers experienced errors, 2 paid. Support notified customers and posted incident advisory. Any risk of throttling legitimate high-throughput tenants?
Maya (SRE): risk low; we've set per-tenant caps and logged throttled tenants. We're monitoring for false positives.
Toby (Support): CS will follow up with affected paid customers and document mitigation actions.
Jordan (Oncall): handoff: I'm handing incident to Maya for post-mitigation cleanup and RCA. I'll remain on-call for any regression.
Maya (SRE): taking over. Next steps: collect routing logs, correlate policy rollout timeline, prepare RCA draft. Target: preliminary report in 3 hours.
CustomerOps Bot: Noted. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-4492 and adding CS and legal tags for paid customer outreach.
Jordan (Oncall): closing live mitigations: rollout disabled, economy rate-limit applied, per-tenant override for acct-9876, prefix cache enabled. Monitoring for 30m.
Maya (SRE): monitoring looks stable at T+12m, errors down to baseline. Will escalate if anything changes. :eyes:
IncidentBot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pages cleared.
Maya (SRE): thanks all — I’ll kick off an RCA with routing and infra teams to prevent future policy defaults from sending economy traffic to premium lanes.
Toby (Support): logging notes for customers and tagging follow-up. :memo:
Jordan (Oncall): great work. :thumbsup:
